title: R94 play-level rate substrate (measure only)
description: scripts/build_wet_rates.py's mechanism corpus: the completions, attempts, targets, receptions, yards, sacks and fumble counts that data/fixtures/backtest_weekly/weekly_actuals.json throws away. One document per unit - player_week and team_week - in the same shape, because the weather measurement pools the same sixteen counters over both. Numerators and denominators are stored SEPARATELY and never pre-divided: a rate pooled over a cell is sum(numerators)/sum(denominators), which only the stored counts can produce. This document REPORTS. Nothing that ships reads it, it fits nothing, it adopts nothing, and no market number appears anywhere in it. A season that could not be fetched is named in seasons_unavailable and is ABSENT from rows: a season key may never map to an empty object, because an empty season and a hole are the same file to a consumer and only one of them is honest. provenance says whether the corpus was pulled from the nflverse release or is the hand-made synthetic placeholder committed for the offline selftest; build_wet_rates.available() refuses the placeholder, so a consumer is told no rather than measuring on invented numbers.

unit.description: The unit of analysis. player_week keys are {week}|{team}|{player_id}; team_week keys are {week}|{team}.

provenance.description: nflverse_release is a real pull and may be measured on. synthetic_fixture is the committed hand-made placeholder and may not: available() refuses it by this field, never by guessing from the row count.

seasons_unavailable.description: {season: why}. An empty object is the only claim that every requested season was read.

required_columns.description: The logical column contract asserted against every fetched header. All twenty-four must resolve: there is no optional mechanism column, because a column that went missing would otherwise read as a zero and price the weather as catastrophic.

rows.description: {season: {key: row}}. A season present here was fetched in full; a season that was not is absent and named in seasons_unavailable.

opp.description: null only when the feed itself carried no opponent; it is never filled in from elsewhere.

players.description: team_week only: how many kept player rows were summed into this team-week. A completeness witness - three rows is a truncated pull, not a roster.
